name: clox-playground-vendor
description: Builds codemirror.js (the one-file CodeMirror 6 bundle) and copies the Inter and JetBrains Mono web fonts into fonts/. Run `npm ci && npm run build && npm run fonts` here after changing a version; the output is committed, so the site itself needs no build step.

scripts.fonts: mkdir -p fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 fonts/inter-latin-variable.woff2 && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2 fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-variable.woff2 && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-italic.woff2 fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-variable-italic.woff2 && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/LICENSE fonts/LICENSE-Inter.txt && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/LICENSE fonts/LICENSE-JetBrainsMono.txt
